comment: BENCH-05: model-free, RepoQA-derived code-retrieval diagnostic. Ground truth is written by hand from the seeded symbol list, never from the retrieval under test. This is a synthetic 21-symbol seed across 3 languages with 21 hand-written queries; it is NOT an official RepoQA score and must never be extrapolated to a full RepoQA suite or to real repositories. Retrieval is the engine's deterministic FTS rank; latency is reported separately and excluded from the gate.
